notes.title: A major update!) New level of interaction and content!
notes.content:
Dear players! We present to you new changes and improvements in the project. Here are the key points to pay attention to:

[list]
[*] [b]Texture Update:[/b] Some textures in various chapters of the game have been changed, allowing you to enjoy a new visual experience.
[*] [b]Text Localization:[/b] The full localization of the text has been almost completed, so when you switch to Russian, you will be able to immerse yourself even deeper into the game.
[*] [b]Changes to Story Cassettes:[/b] Changes have been made to the content of the cassettes, making the story even more engaging and interesting.
[*] [b]Secret Ending:[/b] A new secret ending has been added, which you will need to uncover during your playthrough!
[*] [b]Cassette Notifications:[/b] Now, when you pick up a cassette, you will receive a notification, and the cassettes you collect will be saved and will no longer appear on the map.
[*] [b]Pause Menu Changes:[/b] The "Pause" menu has been optimized for more convenient interactions.
[*] [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] A range of bugs have been addressed, fixing several issues that could interfere with gameplay.
[*] [b]Revamp of Save Files:[/b] Please note that the save file has been completely redone, which means you will need to start the game from the beginning. This is a necessary measure for the proper functioning of future updates.
[*] [b]Menu Changes with Progress:[/b] Now the menu will change depending on your progress in the game, allowing for an even better immersion in the atmosphere of what’s happening.
[*] [b]Damage Visualization:[/b] When inflicting damage to Nick during the boss fight with the doppelgänger, there will now be a visualization of that damage, which will help you better control the situation.
[*] [b]Mini-game Changes:[/b] The mini-game before the "Circus" area has been modified.
[*] [b]New Achievement:[/b] A new achievement related to the secret ending has been added.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy these changes and that they make your gameplay even more exciting! Thank you for staying with us! Meow :3
